Name: Sanguine Authority
Description:
You draw out or control your own blood to produce a minor effect in the area around yourself, the amount might seem large yet it is always insubstantial to your health. You may use such for the following effects:

- Paint a small (1-ft) object red, you may also do so with small (5ft feet) bodies of water or let the blood fuse into the fire of torches, rendering them blood-red.

- Emit a red mist that encroaches around an 20-ft area.

- Use your own blood to write a message on a 15-ft surface.

- Change your eyes color to a full shade of red.

- Emit a small tendril that can be used to carry objects of up to 5 pounds and interact with non-magical objects.
